title: Loop Operators and Microscopic Nonabelian Anyons
exact_target: Construct microscopic loop operators realizing nonabelian anyon transport and statistics.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004242 (OWR-17137-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/41, pp. 2541--2603. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 24.
Abelian anyon index paper (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The admissible Hamiltonians, locality and gap assumptions must follow the source abelian construction. A formal topological field-theory braid representation alone does not produce operators for the requested microscopic models.
